ONSET — when will the rains START, according to this sign?
how: Two dates, e.g. 20/10/2026 and 31/10/2026 (one date → earliest only)

what: CESSATION — when will the rains END, according to this sign?
how: Two dates, e.g. 05/01/2027 and 20/01/2027; blank if the sign says nothing about the end

what: DISTRIBUTION — how well will the rains be spread in time and place?
how: 3 Good (evenly spread), 2 Fair (some dry spells), 1 Poor (erratic, long dry spells), 0 Not sure

what: AMOUNT — how much rain does the sign point to?
how: 3 above normal, 2 normal, 1 below normal, 0 no prediction yet
